source.original_question: Find the value of h to the nearest metre.

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: Ifd is the nearer distance, h=d tan22°=(d+29)tan10°. Thus h=29/(cot10°-cot22°)=9.007..., rounds9m.
